voice.summary: Pipewise talks like an on-call colleague who has already read the logs. It states the stage, the job and the duration, and keeps its tone even when a build is red.
dos: Lead with the status and the job name
Give durations in seconds or minutes, exactly
Use code font for hashes, branches and commands
donts: Do not blame the author of a failing commit
Do not hide flaky tests behind a green tick
Do not use exclamation marks in logs

taglines: Every stage, every job, one view
Pipelines you can read at a glance
boilerplate: Pipewise is a CI dashboard that shows staged pipelines, parallel jobs and flaky tests so developers can see exactly where a build slowed or failed.

microcopy.error: Run #2839 failed at Unit tests. Open the log for details.
microcopy.empty: No runs yet. Push a commit to start one.

logo.note: Chevrons mark the forward stages of a pipeline, and the lowercase wordmark matches the page.
